EXPLAIN WITH_RECOMMENDATIONS
  SELECT
    COUNT(*),CUST.CUST_NO
    FROM eds.TRU_CUST AS CUST --51314
        LEFT JOIN eds.TRU_BASELINK AS BASE --65683
            ON CUST.CUST_NO = BASE.CIF_NO
            AND CAST('2023-03-21' AS DATE) BETWEEN BASE.SCD_START_DATE AND BASE.SCD_END_DATE
    GROUP BY
    CUST.CUST_NO
    HAVING COUNT(*)>1

SELECT
*
FROM eds.TRU_CUST WHERE CUST_NO='00032204'

SELECT * FROM eds.TRU_BASELINK WHERE CIF_NO='00032204'
